remarks: Rare opportunity to enjoy idyllic setting overlooking river, pond and lush landscaping on two acres. Peaceful and serene oasis off cul-de-sac on west side of town just seven minutes from downtown New Canaan. This one-story home has an open floor plan with a distinctive modern vibe. Tastefully updated throughout with access to multiple entertainment spaces. Views from each room to enjoy the ever changing scenery of the seasons. Experience life in the vibrant community of New Canaan-home of the Philip Johnson Glass House, trendy restaurants, shopping and other cultural attractions-all within an hour of NYC. Landlord would consider furnished at $12,000/month
